# AMCHAM Tanzania

AMCHAM Tanzania is the American Chamber of Commerce in Tanzania. It advances trade and investment between the United States and Tanzania through business advocacy, executive networking, events, publications, investor resources and a trusted member network.

Official name: American Chamber of Commerce in Tanzania
Location: Dar es Salaam, Tanzania
Website: https://amcham-tz.com/
Email: info@amcham-tz.com
Telephone: +255 756 937 378

- About: https://amcham-tz.com/about-us

Use the official website as the primary source for current membership, leadership, events and organizational information.
